x: Nankivell, of Southgate. In the Field Events our big Irish Guardsman, Pat Ridge, won both the Weight and Discus with very creditable efforts.
2 miles (Seniors): 1 Nankivell (S.); 2 Cohen (B.); 3 Bingham (W.M.T.); 4 Eyers (W.M.T.); 7 Gailley; 10 Shields; 12 Morrell; 13 Eeles.

Nankivell, the Southgate runner, won the 2 Miles race, and Tom Clinton was second with Ted Stimpson third. The 440 Yards saw an unfortunate clash between the Police and Southgate runners, both of whom fell, thus leaving our two men to finish alone.
